title: Quote: (on what his greatest creation is: iPhone, iPad?) No. Apple ...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Insights on the writing of Steve Jobs
content: (on what his greatest creation is: iPhone, iPad?) No. Apple -- the company. Because anybody can create products, but Apple keeps creating great products.
full_transcript: (on what his greatest creation is: iPhone, iPad?) No. Apple -- the company. Because anybody can create products, but Apple keeps creating great products.
